root_cause.duplicate_work: The exact deterministic website transform is proven before merge and then repeated by Netlify after merge.
root_cause.hot_step: Static localized-route generation processes the public route set serially even when production uses a complete offline translation cache.

prevention.single_runner: Netlify production, deploy-preview and Required invoke one canonical build runner.
prevention.parallel_i18n: Offline localized-route generation shards independent routes across bounded child processes.
prevention.artifact_reuse: Required uploads the proven post-build workspace under the immutable source Git tree SHA. Production may reuse it only when current main has the same tree SHA.
prevention.fallback: Missing, expired or mismatched artifacts fall back to the unchanged full canonical Netlify source build.
